hypothesis: PCA projection to top-P input components reduces lstsq noise for block 1 (input_rank=192)
result_summary: All PCA variants worse than standard (54.770-55.074 vs 54.689). Best improvement: -0.08 PPL.
interpretation: lstsq handles near-zero-variance input dimensions through numerical conditioning, not needing explicit PCA.
PCA projection adds approximation error in the input transformation itself.
Smaller P is progressively worse (P=192 is worst at +0.39 PPL), confirming that the discarded components carry signal.
The 576 near-zero-variance dimensions in block 1 input do NOT degrade lstsq fit.
